title: A Proof of the Second brick-Brauer-Thrall Conjecture for $E$-infinite algebras
summary: For any finite-dimensional algebra $A$ over an algebraically closed field, we prove that if $A$ is $E$-infinite, then the Second brick-Brauer-Thrall Conjecture holds for $A$. In fact, we show that if there is a rational ray outside the $τ$-tilting fan of $A$, then $A$ admits an infinite family of $θ$-stable bricks of dimension $d$, for some positive integer $d$ and weight $θ$.
